name: Gopal Snacks Ltd
about: Founded in 1999, Gopal Snacks is an FMCG company dealing in ethnic snacks, western snacks, and other products.[1]
keyPoints:
Business Profile[1]
Gopal Snacks Limited is a leading manufacturer in the fast-moving consumer goods (FMCG) sector, specializing in traditional Indian snacks and packaged food products. The company is headquartered in Rajkot and has a strong presence across 12 states and 3 union territories.

pros: Company has a good return on equity (ROE) track record: 3 Years ROE 26.5%
Company has been maintaining a healthy dividend payout of 22.9%
cons: Stock is trading at 9.40 times its book value
The company has delivered a poor sales growth of 10.6% over past five years.
